finalText:
I've fixed the charges on Q-310 (R5210, Ravi Shah) and sent him the correction. The resolution note on the request itself still wrongly says nothing was charged, because the system won't edit a request that's already resolved.

**Why the issue was right:** On 26 July, R5210 was already moved from AA214 to AA210 for free under the Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14). That waiver allows one free move only, and "moves outside these limits fall under the normal fare rules." The amendment (PB-2026-14A) only extends the travel dates for gold and platinum members, and Ravi has no tier. The same-day change rule (PB-2026-12) doesn't apply either, because the move from 3 August to 8 August isn't a same-day change. So the normal economy rules apply.

**What I changed:**
- **L9:** a $75.00 change fee (7500 cents) on R5210. His lack of tier means he isn't exempt from it.
- **L10:** a $30.00 fare difference (3000 cents) on R5210: the $340.00 AA216 economy fare minus the $310.00 he paid.
- **Correction message (N1):** sent to him by email and text. It explains that he used the waiver on the 26 July move, so this change costs $105.00 in total under normal rules. It also says the earlier note was wrong and apologises.

**Still to do:** someone with access to edit resolved requests would need to replace that note with the corrected one. Nothing else was touched.
